page.overview:
What is Magnetic tongs?

Magnetic tongs were a tool used by the Armorer to forge Mandalorian armor. Around 9 ABY, the Armorer used it within her workshop inside the Mandalorian covert on the Outer Rim planet Nevarro to forge Din Djarin's armor.
